verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's Flights product runs scheduled, agent-built Python jobs, and its product page says Flights handle "versioning" along with scheduling, secrets and logging. That is a single thin first-party mention of versioning for automations, with no detail on how versions are reviewed or rolled back. Missing for 10: documented version history mechanics, a review/diff workflow for automation changes, rollback to prior versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
